purpose: Close the registration-versus-action identity gap found by round 21: the first pre-registration froze a reservation condition that is NOT equivalent to the condition the five-day panel actually executed. This stage fixes ONE deployment rule in writing and then proves, by independent per-order re-derivation from the frozen execution log, that the executed decisions are exactly the registered formula. No new utility day, no new seed, no training.

rule_spec.per_order_cost: e_lower(i) = quantity_i * precool_energy_per_unit_per_c * max(0, ambient_c - target_c[class_i])
rule_spec.spent: spent_before = sum of e_lower over the orders currently in the base replanner accepted set; base-SAA acceptances only, so an order the rule admitted but the base rejected does not count
rule_spec.hard_precheck: if e_lower(i) > b_rem: reject with reason 'over_remaining_budget'
rule_spec.clock_bucket: ti = min(max(bisect_right(clock_grid, clock) - 1, 0), len(clock_grid) - 1); clock_grid = 0.0 .. 16.0 step 0.5 (33 values)
rule_spec.price_selection: lambda = the smallest value in the ascending lambda grid with G[lambda][ti] <= b_rem; if no grid value satisfies it, lambda = max(grid); lambda grid = 0.25 .. 8.0 step 0.125 (63 values, rounded to 6 dp)
rule_spec.admit_rule: admit iff REV[class_i] - lambda * e_lower(i) > 0 (strictly greater)
rule_spec.post_admit: the frozen base SAA still decides; the rule can only add rejections, never admit what the base refuses
rule_spec.calibration: G[lambda][ti] = mean over the 200 frozen TRAIN days (seed 20260925) of the sum of e_lower over orders with reveal_time >= clock_grid[ti] and REV - lambda*e_lower > 0; TRAIN only, no gate or fresh day is touched by calibration

budget_B_note: the recomputed budget from the current source tree; the recorded batch budget 710.6548152249378 is NOT reproducible because scenario_saa.py changed after that batch (delta 1.76e-05)

v4_artifacts.role: the execution this replay must reproduce per day, so that the registered rule is the executed rule

replay_days.note: these five days were already consumed by the v4 panel, so the replay can only create engineering evidence, never new utility; the registered plan for fresh days is a later, separately registered stage

primary_metrics: per-order decision agreement between the registered formula and the execution log
per-day utility identity against the v4 recorded candidate rows
counts of decisions, admissions and each reject reason
failure_criteria: any per-order decision or reason mismatch
any per-day utility mismatch against v4
any budget violation or hard-infeasible day
any registered source or data hash mismatch
lambda-table digest mismatch against the independent calibration
stop_rule: on any failure criterion the stage stops at the engineering phase and no utility comparison is proposed
